high_level_description: This image captures a cozy and relaxed moment of someone enjoying a book on what appears to be a Sunday. The person is sitting with their legs crossed, wearing light-colored pants, and holding the book titled "The Book of Everlasting Things" by Aanchal Malhotra. The book cover features an intricate design with floral patterns in blue and green hues, along with a large, polished stone or gemstone at the center. The setting seems to be indoors, possibly in a living room or a comfortable reading nook.
